content.comment_body: I'm encountering an issue with [product_name]; when I enter the IP address, I receive a 504 gateway timeout error on my phone. Any advice?

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a 504 gateway timeout error when trying to access [product_name] via a mobile device.
